title: SODIUM HOURS
description: DAEMON//HEADLINER 001. A machine city learning to sing: the motif is heard as machine (LPG pluck), voice (talkbox), then choir. Original synthesis only.

tracks.description: Tuned F kick and the low boom
Snare/clap laid back ~9 ms, ghosts, rim, hall accents
Swung hats, open hats, shaker, lowrider hydraulics, machine ticks
Straight-grid 3-3-2 metal: pipe, anvil, chain, toms, servo
Industrial grit layer: withheld until the verse pops, open from Hook 2
Machine wet: FDN hall + dotted-eighth ping-pong
The voice: synthetic talkbox lead, dry
Voice wet: FDN hall + dotted-eighth ping-pong
Choir chords and the ensemble that sings the final hook
Rain over freeway rumble, sodium lamp, distant siren
